verses.text: Ezra was praying and confessing, crying and throwing himself down in front of God’s house. A huge crowd of Israelites gathered around him, men, women, and children, and the people broke down in tears.
Shecaniah son of Jehiel, one of Elam’s descendants, answered Ezra, “We’ve wronged our God by marrying foreign women from the peoples of the land. Even now there’s hope for Israel in this.

So let’s make a covenant with our God to send away all these wives and the children born to them. Let’s follow your counsel, my lord, and the counsel of those who tremble at our God’s command. Let it be done according to the law.
Get up. This is yours to handle, and we’re with you. Take courage and do it.”
Ezra got up and made the leading priests, the Levites, and all Israel swear they’d do what had been proposed. And they swore.

Then Ezra got up from in front of God’s house and went into the room of Jehohanan son of Eliashib. Once inside, he ate no food and drank no water. He was grieving over the wrong the returned exiles had done.
They announced throughout Judah and Jerusalem that all the returned exiles had to gather in Jerusalem.
Following the officials’ and elders’ advice, anyone who didn’t show up within three days would lose everything they owned and be put out of the assembly of returned exiles.

Within the three days, all the men of Judah and Benjamin gathered in Jerusalem. It was the twentieth day of the ninth month. Everyone sat in the square in front of God’s house, shaking over what was happening and because of the pouring rain.
Ezra the priest stood up and told them, “You’ve done wrong by marrying foreign women and adding to Israel’s guilt.
Now confess to the LORD, the God of your ancestors, and do what pleases him. Separate yourselves from the peoples of the land and from the foreign women.”
The whole assembly answered loudly, “We have to do what you’ve told us to do.
But there are a lot of us, and the rain is heavy. We can’t stand outside. This won’t be sorted out in a day or two, because we’ve done great wrong in this matter.

Let our officials act for the whole assembly. Everyone in our towns who’s married a foreign woman should come at a set time with their town’s elders and judges. Let’s do this until our God’s fierce anger turns away from us and the matter is resolved.”
Only Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah stood against this. Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite backed them up.

The returned exiles carried out the plan. Ezra the priest and certain family heads were appointed by name to represent their ancestral families. On the first day of the tenth month, they sat down to look into the matter.
By the first day of the first month they’d finished dealing with all the men who had married foreign women.
Here are the men from priestly families found to have married foreign women. From the family of Jeshua son of Jozadak and his brothers: Maaseiah, Eliezer, Jarib, and Gedaliah.
They pledged to send away their wives. As they were guilty, they offered a ram from the flock for their guilt.
From Immer’s descendants: Hanani and Zebadiah.
From Harim’s descendants: Maaseiah, Elijah, Shemaiah, Jehiel, and Uzziah.
From Pashhur’s descendants: Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
From the Levites: Jozabad, Shimei, Kelaiah, also called Kelita, Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
From the singers: Eliashib. From the gatekeepers: Shallum, Telem, and Uri.
From the rest of Israel, from Parosh’s descendants: Ramiah, Izziah, Malchijah, Mijamin, Eleazar, Malchijah, and Benaiah.
From Elam’s descendants: Mattaniah, Zechariah, Jehiel, Abdi, Jeremoth, and Elijah.
From Zattu’s descendants: Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, Jeremoth, Zabad, and Aziza.
From Bebai’s descendants: Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai.
From Bani’s descendants: Meshullam, Malluch, Adaiah, Jashub, Sheal, and Jeremoth.
From Pahathmoab’s descendants: Adna, Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel, Binnui, and Manasseh.
From Harim’s descendants: Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,
Benjamin, Malluch, and Shemariah.
From Hashum’s descendants: Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, and Shimei.
From Bani’s descendants: Maadai, Amram, Uel,
Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi,
Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,
Mattaniah, Mattenai, Jaasu,
Bani, Binnui, Shimei,
Shelemiah, Nathan, Adaiah,
Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,
Azarel, Shelemiah, Shemariah,
Shallum, Amariah, and Joseph.
From Nebo’s descendants: Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Iddo, Joel, and Benaiah.
All these men had married foreign women. Some had children with their wives.
